scope: Independent read-only final preservation and code-diff review; no duplicate suites run
code_diff_basis: Retained audit copy exactly matched pre-state SHA256 for both changed semantic code files

schema_findings.current_contract: Exact int schema 2 is mandatory at current entry points; field never selects legacy mode
schema_findings.custody: All attempted reasoner runs go through selection and invocation-chain verification unconditionally
schema_findings.historical: Separate pinned path+SHA archive reader; current-review and publication ineligible; removed current reconciliation path

retry_findings.design: Accepted fail-before-touch alternative, explicit fresh build/evidence destination per retry
retry_findings.preflight: Checks existing graph, query, reservation, result and known command/output paths, including dangling symlinks, before serialization or any file write
retry_findings.create_once: Reservation, graph, query and result writes use exclusive creation; ticket and capture/envelope already exclusive
retry_findings.prior_attempt_preservation: No code path rewrites an existing slot graph/query/result during a driver retry; fresh destination attempt uses separate graph/query identities
retry_findings.selection: Existing create-once selected-invocations record and verification unchanged

limits: No new semantic judgment or real decision record created
Code review supplements root-run regression matrices; it does not independently rerun them
Current historical blocked semantic evidence remains deliberately ineligible
